istruzioni_en: Holding a barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing down), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The barbell should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.

Now, while keeping the torso stationary, breathe out and lift the barbell to you. Keep the elbows close to the body and only use the forearms to hold the weight. At the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Γόνατα ελαφρώς λυγισμένα, κορμός γερμένος μπροστά με ίσια πλάτη.
Τράβα τη μπάρα προς την κοιλιά σφίγγοντας τις ωμοπλάτες.
Κατέβα αργά με τεντωμένα χέρια.

istruzioni: In piedi, bilanciere all'altezza delle spalle, presa poco più larga delle spalle.
Spingi il bilanciere sopra la testa fino a braccia tese, addome contratto.
Scendi lentamente alle spalle.
istruzioni_en: Start by placing a barbell that is about chest high on a squat rack. Once you have selected the weights, grab the barbell using a pronated (palms facing forward) grip. Make sure to grip the bar wider than shoulder width apart from each other.
Slightly bend the knees and place the barbell on your collar bone. Lift the barbell up keeping it lying on your chest. Take a step back and position your feet shoulder width apart from each other.

Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip length, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Hold at about shoulder level and slightly in front of your head. This is your starting position.
Lower the bar down to the collarbone slowly as you inhale.
Lift the bar back up to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, μπάρα στο ύψος των ώμων, λαβή λίγο πιο ανοιχτή από τους ώμους.
Σπρώξε τη μπάρα πάνω από το κεφάλι μέχρι να τεντωθούν τα χέρια, κοιλιά σφιγμένη.
Κατέβα αργά στους ώμους.

istruzioni: In piedi, bilanciere davanti alle cosce con i palmi in avanti.
Piega i gomiti portando il bilanciere verso le spalle, gomiti fermi.
Scendi lentamente.
istruzioni_en: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at a shoulder-width grip. The palm of your hands should be facing forward and the elbows should be close to the torso. This will be your starting position.
While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Tip: Only the forearms should move.
Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
Slowly begin to bring the bar back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, μπάρα μπροστά στους μηρούς με τις παλάμες προς τα εμπρός.
Λύγισε τους αγκώνες φέρνοντας τη μπάρα προς τους ώμους, αγκώνες ακίνητοι.
Κατέβα αργά.

istruzioni: Bilanciere sulla parte alta della schiena.
Fai un passo in avanti e scendi finché il ginocchio posteriore sfiora il pavimento.
Torna in piedi e alterna le gambe.
istruzioni_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack just below shoulder level. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and step forward with your right leg and squat down through your hips, while keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance. Inhale as you go down. Note: Do not allow your knee to go forward beyond your toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the knee joint. li>
Using mainly the heel of your foot, push up and go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat the movement for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
istruzioni_el: Μπάρα στο πάνω μέρος της πλάτης.
Κάνε ένα βήμα μπροστά και κατέβα μέχρι το πίσω γόνατο να αγγίξει σχεδόν το πάτωμα.
Σήκω όρθιος και άλλαζε πόδια.

istruzioni: In piedi, tieni un disco con due mani davanti alle cosce, braccia quasi tese.
Solleva il disco davanti a te fino all'altezza degli occhi.
Scendi lentamente.
istruzioni_en: While standing straight, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions. Your palms should be facing each other and your arms should be extended and locked with a slight bend at the elbows and the plate should be down near your waist in front of you as far as you can go. Tip: The arms will remain in this position throughout the exercise. This will be your starting position.

Slowly raise the plate as you exhale until it is a little above shoulder level. Hold the contraction for a second. Tip: make sure that you do not swing the weight or bend at the elbows. Your torso should remain stationary throughout the movement as well.
As you inhale, slowly lower the plate back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, κράτα έναν δίσκο με τα δύο χέρια μπροστά στους μηρούς, χέρια σχεδόν τεντωμένα.
Σήκωσε τον δίσκο μπροστά σου μέχρι το ύψος των ματιών.
Κατέβα αργά.

istruzioni: Seduto, busto inclinato indietro, gambe sollevate e leggermente piegate, disco davanti all'addome.
Ruota il busto portando il disco da un lato.
Ruota dall'altro lato con un movimento controllato.
istruzioni_en: Lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your legs fully extended and your upper body upright. Grab the plate by its sides with both hands out in front of your abdominals with your arms slightly bent.

Slowly cross your legs near your ankles and lift them up off the ground. Your knees should also be bent slightly. Note: Move your upper body back slightly to help keep you balanced turning this exercise. This is the starting position.
Move the plate to the left side and touch the floor with it. Breathe out as you perform that movement.

Come back to the starting position as you breathe in and then repeat the movement but this time to the right side of the body. Tip: Use a slow controlled movement at all times. Jerking motions can injure the back.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός, κορμός γερμένος πίσω, πόδια σηκωμένα και ελαφρώς λυγισμένα, δίσκος μπροστά στην κοιλιά.
Γύρνα τον κορμό φέρνοντας τον δίσκο στη μία πλευρά.
Γύρνα στην άλλη πλευρά με ελεγχόμενη κίνηση.

istruzioni: Sdraiato sulla schiena, ginocchia piegate, tieni un peso sul petto.
Solleva le spalle da terra contraendo l'addome.
Torna giù lentamente.
istruzioni_en: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Hold a weight to your chest, or you may hold it extended above your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, exhale and slowly begin to roll your shoulders off the floor. Your shoulders should come up off the floor about 4 inches while your lower back remains on the floor.
At the top of the movement, flex your abdominals and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
istruzioni_el: Ξαπλωμένος ανάσκελα, γόνατα λυγισμένα, κράτα ένα βάρος στο στήθος.
Σήκωσε τους ώμους από το πάτωμα σφίγγοντας την κοιλιά.
Κατέβα αργά.

istruzioni: In piedi, tieni l'elastico davanti a te a braccia tese, all'altezza delle spalle.
Apri le braccia tirando l'elastico fino al petto, stringendo le scapole.
Torna lentamente alla posizione iniziale.
istruzioni_en: Begin with your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding the band with both hands.
Initiate the movement by performing a reverse fly motion, moving your hands out laterally to your sides.
Keep your elbows extended as you perform the movement, bringing the band to your chest. Ensure that you keep your shoulders back during the exercise.
Pause as you complete the movement, returning to the starting position under control.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, κράτα το λάστιχο μπροστά σου με τεντωμένα χέρια, στο ύψος των ώμων.
Άνοιξε τα χέρια τραβώντας το λάστιχο ως το στήθος, σφίγγοντας τις ωμοπλάτες.
Γύρνα αργά στην αρχική θέση.

istruzioni: Fissa l'elastico all'altezza del gomito e mettiti di fianco.
Con il gomito piegato a 90° e fermo contro il fianco, ruota l'avambraccio verso l'esterno.
Torna lentamente, poi cambia lato. Utile per proteggere le spalle, anche nel nuoto.
istruzioni_en: Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
istruzioni_el: Στερέωσε το λάστιχο στο ύψος του αγκώνα και στάσου στο πλάι.
Με τον αγκώνα λυγισμένο στις 90° και ακίνητο στο πλευρό, γύρνα τον πήχη προς τα έξω.
Γύρνα αργά, μετά άλλαξε πλευρά. Χρήσιμο για την προστασία των ώμων, και στην κολύμβηση.

istruzioni: In piedi sull'elastico, impugnature ai lati delle cosce.
Solleva le braccia di lato fino all'altezza delle spalle, gomiti leggermente piegati.
Scendi lentamente.
istruzioni_en: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The handles should be resting on the sides of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.

Use your side shoulders to lift the handles to the sides as you exhale. Continue to lift the handles until they are slightly above parallel. Tip: As you lift the handles, slightly tilt the hand as if you were pouring water and keep your arms extended. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the handles back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος πάνω στο λάστιχο, λαβές στα πλάγια των μηρών.
Σήκωσε τα χέρια στο πλάι μέχρι το ύψος των ώμων, αγκώνες ελαφρώς λυγισμένοι.
Κατέβα αργά.

istruzioni: In piedi sull'elastico, impugnature all'altezza delle spalle, palmi in avanti.
Spingi sopra la testa fino a braccia tese.
Scendi lentamente.
istruzioni_en: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles and lift them so that the hands are at shoulder height at each side.
Rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. Your elbows should be bent, with the upper arms and forearms in line to the torso. This is your starting position.
As you exhale, lift the handles up until your arms are fully extended overhead.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος πάνω στο λάστιχο, λαβές στο ύψος των ώμων, παλάμες προς τα εμπρός.
Σπρώξε πάνω από το κεφάλι μέχρι να τεντωθούν τα χέρια.
Κατέβα αργά.

istruzioni: Fissa l'elastico davanti a te all'altezza delle spalle e afferralo a braccia tese.
Apri le braccia di lato tenendole tese, stringendo le scapole.
Torna lentamente.
istruzioni_en: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack.
Grab the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises.

Extend and lift the arms straight in front of you. Tip: Your arms should be straight and parallel to the floor while perpendicular to your torso. Your feet should be firmly planted on the floor spread at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, move your arms to the sides and back. Keep your arms extended and parallel to the floor. Continue the movement until the arms are extended to your sides.
After a pause, go back to the original position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Στερέωσε το λάστιχο μπροστά σου στο ύψος των ώμων και πιάσ' το με τεντωμένα χέρια.
Άνοιξε τα χέρια στο πλάι κρατώντας τα τεντωμένα, σφίγγοντας τις ωμοπλάτες.
Γύρνα αργά.

istruzioni: In piedi, palla medica tenuta con due mani.
Portala sopra la testa distendendo tutto il corpo.
Lanciala con forza a terra davanti a te e riprendila. Usa una palla che non rimbalza.
istruzioni_en: Hold a medine ball with both hands and stand with your feet at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the countermovement by raising the ball above your head and fully extending your body.
Reverse the motion, slamming the ball into the ground directly in front of you as hard as you can.
Receive the ball with both hands on the bounce and repeat the movement.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, μπάλα medicine στα δύο χέρια.
Φέρ' τη πάνω από το κεφάλι τεντώνοντας όλο το σώμα.
Ρίξ' τη δυνατά στο πάτωμα μπροστά σου και πιάσ' τη ξανά. Χρησιμοποίησε μπάλα που δεν αναπηδά.

istruzioni: Sdraiato sulla schiena, talloni sulla fitball.
Solleva il bacino e tira la palla verso i glutei piegando le ginocchia.
Distendi lentamente le gambe tenendo il bacino sollevato.
istruzioni_en: Begin on the floor laying on your back with your feet on top of the ball.
Position the ball so that when your legs are extended your ankles are on top of the ball. This will be your starting position.
Raise your hips off of the ground, keeping your weight on the shoulder blades and your feet.
Flex the knees, pulling the ball as close to you as you can, contracting the hamstrings.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
istruzioni_el: Ξαπλωμένος ανάσκελα, φτέρνες πάνω στη μπάλα γυμναστικής.
Σήκωσε τη λεκάνη και τράβα τη μπάλα προς τους γλουτούς λυγίζοντας τα γόνατα.
Τέντωσε αργά τα πόδια κρατώντας τη λεκάνη ψηλά.

nome_el: Γόνατα στο στήθος σε μπάλα γυμναστικής
istruzioni: In posizione di piegamento con le tibie appoggiate sulla fitball.
Porta le ginocchia verso il petto facendo rotolare la palla.
Distendi le gambe per tornare alla posizione iniziale.
istruzioni_en: Place an exercise ball nearby and lay on the floor in front of it with your hands on the floor shoulder width apart in a push-up position.

Now place your lower shins on top of an exercise ball. Tip: At this point your legs should be fully extended with the shins on top of the ball and the upper body should be in a push-up type of position being supported by your two extended arms in front of you. This will be your starting position.

While keeping your back completely straight and the upper body stationary, pull your knees in towards your chest as you exhale, allowing the ball to roll forward under your ankles. Squeeze your abs and hold that position for a second.
Now slowly straighten your legs, rolling the ball back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Σε θέση κάμψης με τις κνήμες πάνω στη μπάλα γυμναστικής.
Φέρε τα γόνατα προς το στήθος κυλώντας τη μπάλα.
Τέντωσε τα πόδια για να γυρίσεις στην αρχική θέση.

istruzioni: Fai un affondo in avanti con il ginocchio posteriore vicino a terra e resta 10-20 secondi.
Appoggia a terra la mano dal lato della gamba anteriore e ruota il busto portando l'altro braccio verso il soffitto.
Infine distendi la gamba anteriore portando il bacino indietro per allungare i femorali, poi cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your front foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your back foot. With your knees bent, squat down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds.

Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. Your other hand should be placed on the ground, parallel to your lead leg, to help support you during this portion of the stretch.

After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either side of your front foot. Raise the toes of the front foot off of the ground, and straighten your leg. You may need to reposition your rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other side.
istruzioni_el: Κάνε μια προβολή μπροστά με το πίσω γόνατο κοντά στο πάτωμα και μείνε 10-20 δευτερόλεπτα.
Ακούμπησε στο πάτωμα το χέρι από την πλευρά του μπροστινού ποδιού και γύρνα τον κορμό φέρνοντας το άλλο χέρι προς το ταβάνι.
Τέλος τέντωσε το μπροστινό πόδι φέρνοντας τη λεκάνη πίσω για να τεντώσεις τους οπίσθιους μηριαίους, μετά άλλαξε πλευρά.

istruzioni: A quattro zampe, mani sotto le spalle e ginocchia sotto le anche.
Porta dentro l'addome e incurva la schiena verso l'alto, lasciando cadere la testa.
Tieni 15 secondi, poi rilassa.
istruzioni_en: Position yourself on the floor on your hands and knees.
Pull your belly in and round your spine, lower back, shoulders, and neck, letting your head drop.
Hold for 15 seconds.
istruzioni_el: Στα τέσσερα, χέρια κάτω από τους ώμους και γόνατα κάτω από τα ισχία.
Τράβα μέσα την κοιλιά και καμπύλωσε την πλάτη προς τα πάνω, αφήνοντας το κεφάλι να πέσει.
Κράτα 15 δευτερόλεπτα, μετά χαλάρωσε.

istruzioni: In ginocchio, siediti sui talloni.
Piegati in avanti allungando le braccia a terra davanti a te, fronte verso il pavimento.
Respira lentamente e resta 20-30 secondi.
istruzioni_en: Get on your hands and knees, walk your hands in front of you.
Lower your buttocks down to sit on your heels. Let your arms drag along the floor as you sit back to stretch your entire spine.
Once you settle onto your heels, bring your hands next to your feet and relax. "breathe" into your back. Rest your forehead on the floor. Avoid this position if you have knee problems.
istruzioni_el: Γονατιστός, κάθισε στις φτέρνες.
Λύγισε μπροστά τεντώνοντας τα χέρια στο πάτωμα μπροστά σου, μέτωπο προς το πάτωμα.
Ανάπνεε αργά και μείνε 20-30 δευτερόλεπτα.

istruzioni: In ginocchio su un tappetino, porta un piede avanti con il ginocchio a 90°.
Sposta il peso in avanti finché senti allungare la parte anteriore dell'anca della gamba dietro.
Tieni 15-30 secondi, poi cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Kneel on a mat and bring your right knee up so the bottom of your foot is on the floor and extend your left leg out behind you so the top of your foot is on the floor.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in your hip. Hold for 15 seconds, then repeat for your other side.
istruzioni_el: Γονατιστός σε ένα στρωματάκι, φέρε ένα πόδι μπροστά με το γόνατο στις 90°.
Μετέφερε το βάρος μπροστά μέχρι να νιώσεις να τεντώνεται το μπροστινό μέρος του ισχίου του πίσω ποδιού.
Κράτα 15-30 δευτερόλεπτα, μετά άλλαξε πλευρά.

istruzioni: Seduto, una gamba distesa e il piede dell'altra contro l'interno coscia.
Piegati in avanti dalle anche verso la caviglia finché senti allungare il retro della coscia.
Tieni 15-30 secondi, poi cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Sit on a mat with your right leg extended in front of you and your left leg bent with your foot against your right inner thigh.
Lean forward from your hips and reach for your ankle until you feel a stretch in your hamstring. Hold for 15 seconds, then repeat for your other side.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός, το ένα πόδι τεντωμένο και το πέλμα του άλλου στο εσωτερικό του μηρού.
Λύγισε μπροστά από τα ισχία προς τον αστράγαλο μέχρι να νιώσεις να τεντώνεται το πίσω μέρος του μηρού.
Κράτα 15-30 δευτερόλεπτα, μετά άλλαξε πλευρά.

istruzioni: Mani al muro, un piede avanti e uno indietro.
Tieni il tallone posteriore a terra e la gamba tesa, spingendo il bacino verso il muro.
Tieni 15-30 secondi, poi cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Stand facing a wall from several feet away. Stagger your stance, placing one foot forward.
Lean forward and rest your hands on the wall, keeping your heel, hip and head in a straight line.
Attempt to keep your heel on the ground. Hold for 10-20 seconds and then switch sides.
istruzioni_el: Χέρια στον τοίχο, ένα πόδι μπροστά και ένα πίσω.
Κράτα την πίσω φτέρνα στο πάτωμα και το πόδι τεντωμένο, σπρώχνοντας τη λεκάνη προς τον τοίχο.
Κράτα 15-30 δευτερόλεπτα, μετά άλλαξε πλευρά.

nome: Allungamento di soleo e tendine d'Achille
istruzioni: In piedi, un piede avanti e uno indietro, entrambi i talloni a terra.
Piega entrambe le ginocchia spostando il peso sulla gamba posteriore.
Senti allungare la parte bassa del polpaccio: tieni 15-30 secondi e cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other.
Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor. Switch sides.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, ένα πόδι μπροστά και ένα πίσω, και οι δύο φτέρνες στο πάτωμα.
Λύγισε και τα δύο γόνατα μεταφέροντας το βάρος στο πίσω πόδι.
Νιώσε να τεντώνεται το κάτω μέρος της γάμπας: κράτα 15-30 δευτερόλεπτα και άλλαξε πλευρά.

istruzioni: Sdraiato sul fianco, con la gamba di sotto piegata davanti a te per stabilità.
Piega la gamba di sopra e afferra il piede con la mano.
Spingi l'anca in avanti e il piede contro la mano: tieni 15-30 secondi e cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Start off by lying on your right side, with your right knee bent at a 90-degree angle resting on the floor in front of you (this stabilizes the torso).
Bend your left knee behind you and hold your left foot with your left hand. To stretch your hip flexor, press your left hip forward as you push your left foot back into your hand. Switch sides.
istruzioni_el: Ξαπλωμένος στο πλάι, με το κάτω πόδι λυγισμένο μπροστά σου για σταθερότητα.
Λύγισε το πάνω πόδι και πιάσε το πέλμα με το χέρι.
Σπρώξε το ισχίο μπροστά και το πέλμα στο χέρι: κράτα 15-30 δευτερόλεπτα και άλλαξε πλευρά.

istruzioni: Da in piedi porta una gamba indietro e scendi con le mani a terra ai lati del piede anteriore.
Tieni il tallone anteriore a terra.
Per aumentare l'allungamento solleva il bacino distendendo la gamba anteriore.
istruzioni_en: It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start standing up, put one leg behind you, and slowly lower your torso down to the floor.
Keep the front heel on the floor (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).

Place your hands on either side of your front leg. To get more out of this stretch, push your butt up toward the ceiling, and then gradually lower it back toward the floor. You'll Stretch the hip flexor of the back leg and the hamstring and buttocks of the front.
istruzioni_el: Από όρθιος φέρε ένα πόδι πίσω και κατέβα με τα χέρια στο πάτωμα δίπλα στο μπροστινό πόδι.
Κράτα τη μπροστινή φτέρνα στο πάτωμα.
Για πιο έντονη διάταση σήκωσε τη λεκάνη τεντώνοντας το μπροστινό πόδι.

istruzioni: A quattro zampe, solleva da terra un ginocchio piegato.
Disegna con il ginocchio un cerchio ampio e lento.
Fai le ripetizioni in entrambe le direzioni, poi cambia gamba.
istruzioni_en: Position yourself on your hands and knees on the ground. Maintaining good posture, raise one bent knee off of the ground. This will be your starting position.
Keeping the knee in a bent position, rotate the femur in an arc, attempting to make a big circle with your knee.
Perform this slowly for a number of repetitions, and repeat on the other side.
istruzioni_el: Στα τέσσερα, σήκωσε από το πάτωμα ένα λυγισμένο γόνατο.
Σχημάτισε με το γόνατο έναν μεγάλο και αργό κύκλο.
Κάνε τις επαναλήψεις και προς τις δύο κατευθύνσεις, μετά άλλαξε πόδι.

istruzioni: Sdraiato sulla schiena, piedi a terra con i talloni sotto le ginocchia.
Solleva solo il coccige portando dentro l'addome, per allungare la zona lombare.
Poi solleva tutta la colonna, vertebra per vertebra, tranne il collo, e scendi lentamente.
istruzioni_en: Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach.
To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.
istruzioni_el: Ξαπλωμένος ανάσκελα, πέλματα στο πάτωμα με τις φτέρνες κάτω από τα γόνατα.
Σήκωσε μόνο τον κόκκυγα τραβώντας μέσα την κοιλιά, για να τεντώσεις τη μέση.
Μετά σήκωσε όλη τη σπονδυλική στήλη, σπόνδυλο σπόνδυλο, εκτός από τον αυχένα, και κατέβα αργά.

istruzioni: Seduto su una sedia con la schiena dritta, mani intrecciate dietro la testa.
Ruota il busto da un lato il più possibile, poi dall'altro.
Ripeti 3 volte per lato con movimenti lenti.
istruzioni_en: Sit in a chair so your back is straight and your feet planted on the floor.
Interlace your fingers behind your head, elbows out and your chin down.
Twist your upper body to one side about 3 times as far as you can. Then lean forward and twist your torso to reach your elbow to the floor on the inside of your knee.
Return to upright position and then repeat for your other side.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός σε καρέκλα με ίσια πλάτη, χέρια πλεγμένα πίσω από το κεφάλι.
Γύρνα τον κορμό στη μία πλευρά όσο μπορείς, μετά στην άλλη.
Επανάλαβε 3 φορές για κάθε πλευρά με αργές κινήσεις.

nome: Allungamento della parte alta della schiena
istruzioni: Intreccia le dita con i pollici verso il basso.
Spingi le mani in avanti arrotondando le spalle.
Tieni 15-20 secondi.
istruzioni_en: Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your shoulders as you reach your hands forward.
istruzioni_el: Πλέξε τα δάχτυλα με τους αντίχειρες προς τα κάτω.
Σπρώξε τα χέρια μπροστά στρογγυλεύοντας τους ώμους.
Κράτα 15-20 δευτερόλεπτα.

istruzioni: Porta un braccio teso davanti al corpo, verso la spalla opposta.
Con l'altra mano tienilo vicino al petto.
Tieni 15-20 secondi, poi cambia braccio.
istruzioni_en: Reach your left arm across your body and hold it straight.
istruzioni_el: Φέρε ένα τεντωμένο χέρι μπροστά από το σώμα, προς τον αντίθετο ώμο.
Με το άλλο χέρι κράτα το κοντά στο στήθος.
Κράτα 15-20 δευτερόλεπτα, μετά άλλαξε χέρι.

istruzioni: Porta una mano dietro la testa.
Con l'altra mano afferra il gomito e tiralo delicatamente.
Tieni 10-20 secondi, poi cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Reach your hand behind your head, grasp your elbow and gently pull. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.
istruzioni_el: Φέρε ένα χέρι πίσω από το κεφάλι.
Με το άλλο χέρι πιάσε τον αγκώνα και τράβα τον απαλά.
Κράτα 10-20 δευτερόλεπτα, μετά άλλαξε πλευρά.

istruzioni: In piedi, braccia tese davanti a te con le mani unite.
Apri le braccia indietro più che puoi, tenendole tese, e richiudile.
Ripeti 5-10 volte aumentando gradualmente la velocità.
istruzioni_en: Stand with your hands together, arms extended directly in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight, quickly move your arms back as far as possible and back in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion. Repeat 5-10 times, increasing speed as you do so.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, χέρια τεντωμένα μπροστά σου με τις παλάμες ενωμένες.
Άνοιξε τα χέρια πίσω όσο μπορείς, κρατώντας τα τεντωμένα, και κλείσ' τα ξανά.
Επανάλαβε 5-10 φορές αυξάνοντας σιγά σιγά την ταχύτητα.

istruzioni: In piedi, braccia aperte di lato all'altezza delle spalle.
Disegna piccoli cerchi, allargandoli man mano.
Ripeti nell'altra direzione.
istruzioni_en: Stand up and extend your arms straight out by the sides. The arms should be parallel to the floor and perpendicular (90-degree angle) to your torso. This will be your starting position.
Slowly start to make circles of about 1 foot in diameter with each outstretched arm. Breathe normally as you perform the movement.
Continue the circular motion of the outstretched arms for about ten seconds. Then reverse the movement, going the opposite direction.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος, χέρια ανοιχτά στο πλάι στο ύψος των ώμων.
Σχημάτισε μικρούς κύκλους, μεγαλώνοντάς τους σιγά σιγά.
Επανάλαβε προς την άλλη κατεύθυνση.

istruzioni: Seduto o in piedi, solleva un piede da terra.
Ruota lentamente la caviglia disegnando ampi cerchi.
Ripeti nell'altra direzione e cambia piede.
istruzioni_en: Use a sturdy object like a squat rack to hold yourself.

Lift the right leg in the air (just around 2 inches from the floor) and perform a circular motion with the big toe. Pretend that you are drawing a big circle with it. Tip: One circle equals 1 repetition. Breathe normally as you perform the movement.
When you are done with the right foot, then repeat with the left leg.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός ή όρθιος, σήκωσε ένα πόδι από το πάτωμα.
Γύρνα αργά τον αστράγαλο σχηματίζοντας μεγάλους κύκλους.
Επανάλαβε προς την άλλη κατεύθυνση και άλλαξε πόδι.

istruzioni: A pancia in giù, appoggiato sugli avambracci, con il rullo sotto le cosce.
Fai scorrere il rullo dall'anca al ginocchio.
Fermati 10-20 secondi sui punti più tesi.
istruzioni_en: Lay facedown on the floor with your weight supported by your hands or forearms. Place a foam roll underneath one leg on the quadriceps, and keep the foot off of the ground. Make sure to relax the leg as much as possible. This will be your starting position.
Shifting as much weight onto the leg to be stretched as is tolerable, roll over the foam from above the knee to below the hip, holding points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Switch sides.
istruzioni_el: Μπρούμυτα, στηριγμένος στους πήχεις, με το foam roller κάτω από τους μηρούς.
Κύλησε το foam roller από το ισχίο ως το γόνατο.
Σταμάτα 10-20 δευτερόλεπτα στα πιο σφιγμένα σημεία.

istruzioni: Seduto, rullo sotto i polpacci e mani a terra dietro di te.
Solleva il bacino e fai scorrere il rullo dalla caviglia al ginocchio.
Per aumentare la pressione accavalla una gamba sull'altra.
istruzioni_en: Begin seated on the floor. Place a foam roller underneath your lower leg. Your other leg can either be crossed over the opposite or be placed on the floor, supporting some of your weight. This will be your starting position.

Place your hands to your side or just behind you, and press down to raise your hips off of the floor, placing much of your weight against your calf muscle. Roll from below the knee to above the ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for the other leg.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός, foam roller κάτω από τις γάμπες και χέρια στο πάτωμα πίσω σου.
Σήκωσε τη λεκάνη και κύλησε το foam roller από τον αστράγαλο ως το γόνατο.
Για περισσότερη πίεση βάλε το ένα πόδι πάνω στο άλλο.

istruzioni: Sul fianco, rullo sotto la parte esterna della coscia, appoggiato sull'avambraccio.
Fai scorrere il rullo dall'anca al ginocchio.
Usa l'altra gamba a terra per regolare la pressione, poi cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Lay on your side, with the bottom leg placed onto a foam roller between the hip and the knee. The other leg can be crossed in front of you.
Place as much of your weight as is tolerable onto your bottom leg; there is no need to keep your bottom leg in contact with the ground. Be sure to relax the muscles of the leg you are stretching.
Roll your leg over the foam from you hip to your knee, pausing for 10-30 seconds at points of tension. Repeat with the opposite leg.
istruzioni_el: Στο πλάι, foam roller κάτω από το εξωτερικό μέρος του μηρού, στηριγμένος στον πήχη.
Κύλησε το foam roller από το ισχίο ως το γόνατο.
Χρησιμοποίησε το άλλο πόδι στο πάτωμα για να ρυθμίσεις την πίεση, μετά άλλαξε πλευρά.

istruzioni: Seduto, rullo sotto il retro delle cosce, mani a terra dietro di te.
Solleva il bacino e fai scorrere il rullo dal gluteo al ginocchio.
Fermati sui punti più tesi.
istruzioni_en: In a seated position, extend your legs over a foam roll so that it is position on the back of the upper legs. Place your hands to the side or behind you to help support your weight. This will be your starting position.
Using your hands, lift your hips off of the floor and shift your weight on the foam roll to one leg. Relax the hamstrings of the leg you are stretching.
Roll over the foam from below the hip to above the back of the knee, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for the other leg.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός, foam roller κάτω από το πίσω μέρος των μηρών, χέρια στο πάτωμα πίσω σου.
Σήκωσε τη λεκάνη και κύλησε το foam roller από τον γλουτό ως το γόνατο.
Σταμάτα στα πιο σφιγμένα σημεία.

istruzioni: Seduto sul rullo, accavalla una caviglia sul ginocchio opposto.
Inclinati verso il lato della gamba accavallata e fai scorrere il rullo sul gluteo.
Poi cambia lato.
istruzioni_en: Sit with your buttocks on top of a foam roll. Bend your knees, and then cross one leg so that the ankle is over the knee. This will be your starting position.

Shift your weight to the side of the crossed leg, rolling over the buttocks until you feel tension in your upper glute. You may assist the stretch by using one hand to pull the bent knee towards your chest. Hold this position for 10-30 seconds, and then switch sides.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός πάνω στο foam roller, βάλε τον έναν αστράγαλο πάνω στο αντίθετο γόνατο.
Γείρε προς την πλευρά του ποδιού που είναι από πάνω και κύλησε το foam roller στον γλουτό.
Μετά άλλαξε πλευρά.

nome: Rullo sulla parte alta della schiena
nome_el: Foam roller στο πάνω μέρος της πλάτης
istruzioni: Sdraiato sulla schiena, rullo sotto la parte alta della schiena e braccia incrociate davanti.
Solleva il bacino e fai scorrere il rullo tra le scapole.
Sposta il peso un po' a destra e un po' a sinistra.
istruzioni_en: Lay down with your back on the floor. Place a foam roll underneath your upper back, and cross your arms in front of you, protracting your shoulders. This will be your starting position.

Raise your hips off of the ground, placing your weight onto the foam roll. Shift your weight to one side at a time, rolling over your middle and upper back. Pause at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.
istruzioni_el: Ξαπλωμένος ανάσκελα, foam roller κάτω από το πάνω μέρος της πλάτης και χέρια σταυρωμένα μπροστά.
Σήκωσε τη λεκάνη και κύλησε το foam roller ανάμεσα στις ωμοπλάτες.
Μετέφερε λίγο το βάρος δεξιά και λίγο αριστερά.

istruzioni: Siediti con le cosce bloccate sotto i rulli e afferra la barra più larga delle spalle.
Petto in fuori, tira la barra verso la parte alta del petto portando i gomiti giù e indietro.
Risali lentamente fino a braccia tese, senza dondolare con il busto.
istruzioni_en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull down the bar using the forearms.

After a second at the contracted position squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Κάθισε με τους μηρούς κλειδωμένους κάτω από τα μαξιλαράκια και πιάσε τη μπάρα πιο ανοιχτά από τους ώμους.
Στήθος έξω, τράβα τη μπάρα προς το πάνω μέρος του στήθους φέρνοντας τους αγκώνες κάτω και πίσω.
Ανέβα αργά μέχρι να τεντωθούν τα χέρια, χωρίς να κουνάς τον κορμό.

istruzioni: Afferra la barra con le mani alla larghezza delle spalle, palmi in avanti.
Tira la barra verso il petto tenendo i gomiti vicini al corpo.
Torna su lentamente fino a sentire i dorsali allungati.
istruzioni_en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than your shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you - while holding the bar at the chosen grip width - bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary (only the arms should move). The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull the bar down using the forearms.

After a second in the contracted position, while squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement.
6. Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Πιάσε τη μπάρα με τα χέρια στο πλάτος των ώμων, παλάμες προς τα εμπρός.
Τράβα τη μπάρα προς το στήθος κρατώντας τους αγκώνες κοντά στο σώμα.
Ανέβα αργά μέχρι να νιώσεις τους ραχιαίους να τεντώνονται.

istruzioni: Afferra la barra con i palmi verso di te, mani alla larghezza delle spalle.
Tira fino al petto portando i gomiti verso i fianchi.
Risali lentamente: lavorano anche i bicipiti.
istruzioni_en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.
Grab the pull-down bar with the palms facing your torso (a supinated grip). Make sure that the hands are placed closer than the shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

As you breathe out, pull the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the fully contracted position and keep the elbows close to your body. The upper torso should remain stationary as your bring the bar to you and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, while breathing in, slowly bring the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Πιάσε τη μπάρα με τις παλάμες προς εσένα, χέρια στο πλάτος των ώμων.
Τράβα ως το στήθος φέρνοντας τους αγκώνες προς τα πλευρά.
Ανέβα αργά: δουλεύουν και οι δικέφαλοι.

istruzioni: In piedi davanti al cavo alto, afferra la barra a braccia quasi tese.
Con il busto leggermente inclinato in avanti, porta la barra verso le cosce senza piegare i gomiti.
Torna su lentamente fino all'altezza della testa.
istruzioni_en: You will start by grabbing the wide bar from the top pulley of a pulldown machine and using a wider than shoulder-width pronated (palms down) grip. Step backwards two feet or so.

Bend your torso forward at the waist by around 30-degrees with your arms fully extended in front of you and a slight bend at the elbows. If your arms are not fully extended then you need to step a bit more backwards until they are. Once your arms are fully extended and your torso is slightly bent at the waist, tighten the lats and then you are ready to begin.
While keeping the arms straight, pull the bar down by contracting the lats until your hands are next to the side of the thighs. Breathe out as you perform this step.
While keeping the arms straight, go back to the starting position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος μπροστά στην ψηλή τροχαλία, πιάσε τη μπάρα με σχεδόν τεντωμένα χέρια.
Με τον κορμό ελαφρώς γερμένο μπροστά, φέρε τη μπάρα προς τους μηρούς χωρίς να λυγίσεις τους αγκώνες.
Ανέβα αργά μέχρι το ύψος του κεφαλιού.

istruzioni: Siediti con i piedi sulla pedana e le ginocchia leggermente piegate, schiena dritta.
Tira la maniglia verso l'ombelico portando i gomiti indietro e stringendo le scapole.
Torna avanti lentamente a braccia tese, senza curvare la schiena.
istruzioni_en: For this exercise you will need access to a low pulley row machine with a V-bar. Note: The V-bar will enable you to have a neutral grip where the palms of your hands face each other. To get into the starting position, first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the V-bar handles.

With your arms extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lats as you hold the bar in front of you. This is the starting position of the exercise.

Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it until you touch the abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Κάθισε με τα πόδια στο πατάκι και τα γόνατα ελαφρώς λυγισμένα, πλάτη ίσια.
Τράβα τη λαβή προς τον αφαλό φέρνοντας τους αγκώνες πίσω και σφίγγοντας τις ωμοπλάτες.
Γύρνα μπροστά αργά με τεντωμένα χέρια, χωρίς να καμπουριάσεις την πλάτη.

istruzioni: Seduto o in piedi, afferra la maniglia con una mano sola, busto fermo.
Tira la maniglia verso il fianco portando il gomito indietro.
Torna lentamente a braccio teso e ripeti con l'altro braccio.
istruzioni_en: To get into the starting position, first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the single handle attachment with your left arm using a palms-down grip.

With your arm extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lat as you hold the bar in front of you. The right arm can be kept by the waist. This is the starting position of the exercise.

Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it as you rotate the wrist, so that by the time your hand is by your abdominals it is in a neutral position (palms facing the torso). Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard.

Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in. Tip: Remember to rotate the wrist as you go back to the starting position so that the palms are facing down again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform the same movement with the right hand.
istruzioni_el: Καθιστός ή όρθιος, πιάσε τη λαβή με ένα μόνο χέρι, κορμός ακίνητος.
Τράβα τη λαβή προς το πλευρό φέρνοντας τον αγκώνα πίσω.
Γύρνα αργά με τεντωμένο χέρι και επανάλαβε με το άλλο χέρι.

istruzioni: Regola il sedile in modo che le maniglie siano all'altezza del petto, petto contro il cuscino.
Tira le maniglie verso di te portando i gomiti indietro e stringendo le scapole.
Torna avanti lentamente fino a braccia tese.
istruzioni_en: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that the handles are at chest level. Grasp the handles with either a neutral or pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your shoulder blades as you flex the elbow.

Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handles to the starting position. For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
istruzioni_el: Ρύθμισε το κάθισμα ώστε οι λαβές να είναι στο ύψος του στήθους, στήθος στο μαξιλάρι.
Τράβα τις λαβές προς εσένα φέρνοντας τους αγκώνες πίσω και σφίγγοντας τις ωμοπλάτες.
Γύρνα μπροστά αργά μέχρι να τεντωθούν τα χέρια.

istruzioni: Siediti con le maniglie in alto davanti a te e le cosce bloccate.
Tira le maniglie in basso e indietro, verso il petto, stringendo le scapole.
Torna su lentamente controllando il peso.
istruzioni_en: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you. Adjust the knee pad to help keep you down. Grasp the handles with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your shoulder blades as you flex the elbow.
Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handles to the starting position.
For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
istruzioni_el: Κάθισε με τις λαβές ψηλά μπροστά σου και τους μηρούς κλειδωμένους.
Τράβα τις λαβές κάτω και πίσω, προς το στήθος, σφίγγοντας τις ωμοπλάτες.
Ανέβα αργά ελέγχοντας το βάρος.

istruzioni: Cavo all'altezza del viso con la corda: afferrala con i pollici verso di te.
Tira la corda verso la fronte aprendo le mani e portando i gomiti in alto e indietro.
Torna lentamente: lavorano i deltoidi posteriori e la postura.
istruzioni_en: Facing a high pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, pull the weight directly towards your face, separating your hands as you do so. Keep your upper arms parallel to the ground.
istruzioni_el: Τροχαλία στο ύψος του προσώπου με το σχοινί: πιάσ' το με τους αντίχειρες προς εσένα.
Τράβα το σχοινί προς το μέτωπο ανοίγοντας τα χέρια και φέρνοντας τους αγκώνες ψηλά και πίσω.
Γύρνα αργά: δουλεύουν οι οπίσθιοι δελτοειδείς και η στάση του σώματος.

istruzioni: Regola il sedile in modo che le maniglie siano all'altezza del centro del petto.
Spingi le maniglie in avanti fino a braccia quasi tese, senza staccare la schiena.
Torna indietro lentamente fino a sentire il petto allungato.
istruzioni_en: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the bottom or middle of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion.
Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
istruzioni_el: Ρύθμισε το κάθισμα ώστε οι λαβές να είναι στο ύψος της μέσης του στήθους.
Σπρώξε τις λαβές μπροστά μέχρι τα χέρια να τεντωθούν σχεδόν, χωρίς να ξεκολλήσει η πλάτη.
Γύρνα πίσω αργά μέχρι να νιώσεις το στήθος να τεντώνεται.

istruzioni: Siediti con la schiena appoggiata e le maniglie all'altezza della parte alta del petto.
Spingi in avanti e verso l'alto fino a braccia quasi tese.
Torna lentamente: lavora di più la parte alta del petto.
istruzioni_en: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
istruzioni_el: Κάθισε με την πλάτη ακουμπισμένη και τις λαβές στο ύψος του πάνω στήθους.
Σπρώξε μπροστά και πάνω μέχρι τα χέρια να τεντωθούν σχεδόν.
Γύρνα αργά: δουλεύει περισσότερο το πάνω στήθος.

istruzioni: Siediti con la schiena appoggiata, braccia aperte sui cuscinetti o sulle maniglie.
Chiudi le braccia davanti al petto stringendo i pettorali.
Riapri lentamente fino a sentire il petto allungato, senza andare oltre.
istruzioni_en: Sit on the machine with your back flat on the pad.
Take hold of the handles. Tip: Your upper arms should be positioned parallel to the floor; adjust the machine accordingly. This will be your starting position.
Push the handles together slowly as you squeeze your chest in the middle. Breathe out during this part of the motion and hold the contraction for a second.
Return back to the starting position slowly as you inhale until your chest muscles are fully stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Κάθισε με την πλάτη ακουμπισμένη, χέρια ανοιχτά στα μαξιλαράκια ή στις λαβές.
Κλείσε τα χέρια μπροστά στο στήθος σφίγγοντας τους θωρακικούς.
Άνοιξε ξανά αργά μέχρι να νιώσεις το στήθος να τεντώνεται, όχι παραπέρα.

istruzioni: Siediti con il petto contro lo schienale e afferra le maniglie a braccia tese davanti.
Apri le braccia all'indietro stringendo le scapole.
Torna lentamente: lavorano i deltoidi posteriori e la parte alta della schiena.
istruzioni_en: Adjust the handles so that they are fully to the rear. Make an appropriate weight selection and adjust the seat height so the handles are at shoulder level. Grasp the handles with your hands facing inwards. This will be your starting position.
In a semicircular motion, pull your hands out to your side and back, contracting your rear delts.
Keep your arms slightly bent throughout the movement, with all of the motion occurring at the shoulder joint.
Pause at the rear of the movement, and slowly return the weight to the starting position.
istruzioni_el: Κάθισε με το στήθος στην πλάτη του καθίσματος και πιάσε τις λαβές με τεντωμένα χέρια μπροστά.
Άνοιξε τα χέρια προς τα πίσω σφίγγοντας τις ωμοπλάτες.
Γύρνα αργά: δουλεύουν οι οπίσθιοι δελτοειδείς και το πάνω μέρος της πλάτης.

istruzioni: Al centro tra i due cavi alti, una maniglia per mano, un piede avanti.
Con i gomiti appena piegati, porta le mani una verso l'altra davanti al petto.
Riapri lentamente fino a sentire il petto allungato.
istruzioni_en: To get yourself into the starting position, place the pulleys on a high position (above your head), select the resistance to be used and hold the pulleys in each hand.

Step forward in front of an imaginary straight line between both pulleys while pulling your arms together in front of you. Your torso should have a small forward bend from the waist. This will be your starting position.

With a slight bend on your elbows in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon, extend your arms to the side (straight out at both sides) in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on your chest. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout the movement, the arms and torso should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the shoulder joint.
Return your arms back to the starting position as you breathe out. Make sure to use the same arc of motion used to lower the weights.
Hold for a second at the starting position and repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Στη μέση ανάμεσα στις δύο ψηλές τροχαλίες, μία λαβή σε κάθε χέρι, ένα πόδι μπροστά.
Με τους αγκώνες ελάχιστα λυγισμένους, φέρε τα χέρια το ένα προς το άλλο μπροστά στο στήθος.
Άνοιξε ξανά αργά μέχρι να νιώσεις το στήθος να τεντώνεται.

istruzioni: Cavi in basso, una maniglia per mano, busto dritto.
Porta le mani in alto e davanti, all'altezza del viso, con i gomiti appena piegati.
Torna giù lentamente: lavora la parte alta del petto.
istruzioni_en: To move into the starting position, place the pulleys at the low position, select the resistance to be used and grasp a handle in each hand.
Step forward, gaining tension in the pulleys. Your palms should be facing forward, hands below the waist, and your arms straight. This will be your starting position.
With a slight bend in your arms, draw your hands upward and toward the midline of your body. Your hands should come together in front of your chest, palms facing up.
Return your arms back to the starting position after a brief pause.
istruzioni_el: Τροχαλίες χαμηλά, μία λαβή σε κάθε χέρι, κορμός ίσιος.
Φέρε τα χέρια πάνω και μπροστά, στο ύψος του προσώπου, με τους αγκώνες ελάχιστα λυγισμένους.
Κατέβα αργά: δουλεύει το πάνω στήθος.

istruzioni: Regola il sedile in modo che le maniglie siano all'altezza delle spalle.
Spingi verso l'alto fino a braccia quasi tese, schiena appoggiata.
Torna giù lentamente fino all'altezza delle orecchie.
istruzioni_en: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the shoulders at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and handles held with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles upward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight to just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
istruzioni_el: Ρύθμισε το κάθισμα ώστε οι λαβές να είναι στο ύψος των ώμων.
Σπρώξε προς τα πάνω μέχρι τα χέρια να τεντωθούν σχεδόν, πλάτη ακουμπισμένη.
Κατέβα αργά μέχρι το ύψος των αυτιών.

istruzioni: Di fianco al cavo basso, afferra la maniglia con la mano più lontana.
Alza il braccio di lato fino all'altezza della spalla, gomito appena piegato.
Torna giù lentamente e ripeti dall'altro lato.
istruzioni_en: Start by standing to the right side of a low pulley row. Use your left hand to come across the body and grab a single handle attached to the low pulley with a pronated grip (palms facing down). Rest your arm in front of you. Your right hand should grab the machine for better support and balance.
Make sure that your back is erect and your feet are shoulder width apart from each other. This is the starting position.
Begin to use the left hand and come across your body out until it is elevated to shoulder height while exhaling.
Feel the contraction at the top for a second and begin to slowly lower the handle back down to the original starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
istruzioni_el: Στο πλάι της χαμηλής τροχαλίας, πιάσε τη λαβή με το χέρι που είναι πιο μακριά.
Σήκωσε το χέρι στο πλάι μέχρι το ύψος του ώμου, αγκώνας ελάχιστα λυγισμένος.
Κατέβα αργά και επανάλαβε από την άλλη πλευρά.

istruzioni: Davanti al cavo alto, afferra la barra con i palmi verso il basso, gomiti stretti ai fianchi.
Spingi la barra in basso fino a braccia tese, muovendo solo gli avambracci.
Risali lentamente fino a circa 90° ai gomiti.
istruzioni_en: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley and grab with an overhand grip (palms facing down) at shoulder width.

Standing upright with the torso straight and a very small inclination forward, bring the upper arms close to your body and perpendicular to the floor. The forearms should be pointing up towards the pulley as they hold the bar. This is your starting position.

Using the triceps, bring the bar down until it touches the front of your thighs and the arms are fully extended perpendicular to the floor. The upper arms should always remain stationary next to your torso and only the forearms should move. Exhale as you perform this movement.
After a second hold at the contracted position, bring the bar slowly up to the starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Μπροστά στην ψηλή τροχαλία, πιάσε τη μπάρα με τις παλάμες προς τα κάτω, αγκώνες κολλητά στα πλευρά.
Σπρώξε τη μπάρα κάτω μέχρι να τεντωθούν τα χέρια, κουνώντας μόνο τους πήχεις.
Ανέβα αργά μέχρι περίπου τις 90° στους αγκώνες.

istruzioni: Afferra la corda al cavo alto con i pollici in su, gomiti stretti ai fianchi.
Spingi in basso e, alla fine, apri un po' le mani verso l'esterno.
Risali lentamente senza muovere i gomiti.
istruzioni_en: Attach a rope attachment to a high pulley and grab with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).

Standing upright with the torso straight and a very small inclination forward, bring the upper arms close to your body and perpendicular to the floor. The forearms should be pointing up towards the pulley as they hold the rope with the palms facing each other. This is your starting position.

Using the triceps, bring the rope down as you bring each side of the rope to the side of your thighs. At the end of the movement the arms are fully extended and perpendicular to the floor. The upper arms should always remain stationary next to your torso and only the forearms should move. Exhale as you perform this movement.
After holding for a second, at the contracted position, bring the rope slowly up to the starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Πιάσε το σχοινί στην ψηλή τροχαλία με τους αντίχειρες προς τα πάνω, αγκώνες κολλητά στα πλευρά.
Σπρώξε κάτω και, στο τέλος, άνοιξε λίγο τα χέρια προς τα έξω.
Ανέβα αργά χωρίς να κουνάς τους αγκώνες.

nome: Tricipiti sopra la testa al cavo
nome_el: Εκτάσεις τρικεφάλων πάνω από το κεφάλι στην τροχαλία
istruzioni: Di spalle al cavo, corda dietro la testa, gomiti alti e vicini.
Distendi le braccia in avanti e in alto senza muovere i gomiti.
Torna lentamente con le mani dietro la testa.
istruzioni_en: Attach a rope to the bottom pulley of the pulley machine.

Grasping the rope with both hands, extend your arms with your hands directly above your head using a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Your elbows should be in close to your head and the arms should be perpendicular to the floor with the knuckles aimed at the ceiling. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower the rope behind your head as you hold the upper arms stationary. Inhale as you perform this movement and pause when your triceps are fully stretched.
Return to the starting position by flexing your triceps as you breathe out.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Με την πλάτη στην τροχαλία, σχοινί πίσω από το κεφάλι, αγκώνες ψηλά και κοντά.
Τέντωσε τα χέρια μπροστά και πάνω χωρίς να κουνάς τους αγκώνες.
Γύρνα αργά με τα χέρια πίσω από το κεφάλι.

istruzioni: Davanti al cavo basso, afferra la barra con i palmi in su, gomiti ai fianchi.
Piega i gomiti portando la barra verso le spalle.
Torna giù lentamente senza dondolare.
istruzioni_en: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a cable curl bar that is attached to a low pulley. Grab the cable bar at shoulder width and keep the elbows close to the torso. The palm of your hands should be facing up (supinated grip). This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the muscle.
Slowly begin to bring the curl bar back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Μπροστά στη χαμηλή τροχαλία, πιάσε τη μπάρα με τις παλάμες προς τα πάνω, αγκώνες στα πλευρά.
Λύγισε τους αγκώνες φέρνοντας τη μπάρα προς τους ώμους.
Κατέβα αργά χωρίς να κουνιέσαι.

istruzioni: Afferra la corda al cavo basso con i pollici in su, gomiti ai fianchi.
Piega i gomiti portando le mani verso le spalle.
Torna giù lentamente: lavorano bicipiti e avambracci.
istruzioni_en: Attach a rope attachment to a low pulley and stand facing the machine about 12 inches away from it.
Grasp the rope with a neutral (palms-in) grip and stand straight up keeping the natural arch of the back and your torso stationary.
Put your elbows in by your side and keep them there stationary during the entire movement. Tip: Only the forearms should move; not your upper arms. This will be your starting position.
Using your biceps, pull your arms up as you exhale until your biceps touch your forearms. Tip: Remember to keep the elbows in and your upper arms stationary.
After a 1 second contraction where you squeeze your biceps, slowly start to bring the weight back to the original position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Πιάσε το σχοινί στη χαμηλή τροχαλία με τους αντίχειρες προς τα πάνω, αγκώνες στα πλευρά.
Λύγισε τους αγκώνες φέρνοντας τα χέρια προς τους ώμους.
Κατέβα αργά: δουλεύουν δικέφαλοι και πήχεις.

istruzioni: In ginocchio davanti al cavo alto, corda tenuta ai lati della testa.
Arrotonda la schiena portando i gomiti verso le ginocchia, senza tirare con le braccia.
Torna su lentamente.
istruzioni_en: Kneel below a high pulley that contains a rope attachment.
Grasp cable rope attachment and lower the rope until your hands are placed next to your face.
Flex your hips slightly and allow the weight to hyperextend the lower back. This will be your starting position.

With the hips stationary, flex the waist as you contract the abs so that the elbows travel towards the middle of the thighs. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction for a second.

Slowly return to the starting position as you inhale. Tip: Make sure that you keep constant tension on the abs throughout the movement. Also, do not choose a weight so heavy that the lower back handles the brunt of the work.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Γονατιστός μπροστά στην ψηλή τροχαλία, σχοινί στα πλάγια του κεφαλιού.
Στρογγύλεψε την πλάτη φέρνοντας τους αγκώνες προς τα γόνατα, χωρίς να τραβάς με τα χέρια.
Ανέβα αργά.

istruzioni: Di fianco al cavo (o all'elastico) all'altezza del petto, maniglia con due mani al petto.
Spingi le mani in avanti a braccia tese senza farti ruotare dal cavo.
Tieni un secondo, torna al petto e ripeti dall'altro lato.
istruzioni_en: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and—if possible—position the cable to shoulder height. If not, a low pulley will suffice.
With your side to the cable, grab the handle with both hands and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable.
With your feet positioned hip-width apart and knees slightly bent, hold the cable to the middle of your chest. This will be your starting position.
Press the cable away from your chest, fully extending both arms. You core should be tight and engaged.
Hold the repetition for several seconds before returning to the starting position.
At the conclusion of the set, repeat facing the other direction.
istruzioni_el: Στο πλάι της τροχαλίας (ή του λάστιχου) στο ύψος του στήθους, λαβή με τα δύο χέρια στο στήθος.
Σπρώξε τα χέρια μπροστά με τεντωμένα χέρια χωρίς να σε γυρίσει η τροχαλία.
Κράτα ένα δευτερόλεπτο, γύρνα στο στήθος και επανάλαβε από την άλλη πλευρά.

istruzioni: Di fianco al cavo alto, maniglia con due mani, piedi alla larghezza delle spalle.
Porta le mani in diagonale verso il basso, ruotando il busto e le anche.
Torna lentamente e ripeti dall'altro lato.
istruzioni_en: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and move the cable to the highest pulley position.

With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the cable.
With your feet positioned shoulder width apart, reach upward with your other hand and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended.
In one motion, pull the handle down and across your body to your front knee while rotating your torso.
Keep your back and arms straight and core tight while you pivot your back foot and bend your knees to get a full range of motion.
Maintain your stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner.
Repeat to failure.
Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.
istruzioni_el: Στο πλάι της ψηλής τροχαλίας, λαβή με τα δύο χέρια, πόδια στο πλάτος των ώμων.
Φέρε τα χέρια διαγώνια προς τα κάτω, γυρίζοντας κορμό και ισχία.
Γύρνα αργά και επανάλαβε από την άλλη πλευρά.

istruzioni: Siediti con la schiena appoggiata, piedi sulla pedana alla larghezza delle spalle.
Togli le sicure e piega le ginocchia verso il petto senza staccare il bacino.
Spingi fino a gambe quasi tese, senza bloccare le ginocchia.
istruzioni_en: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.
istruzioni_el: Κάθισε με την πλάτη ακουμπισμένη, πόδια στο πατάκι στο πλάτος των ώμων.
Βγάλε τις ασφάλειες και λύγισε τα γόνατα προς το στήθος χωρίς να σηκωθεί η λεκάνη.
Σπρώξε μέχρι τα πόδια να τεντωθούν σχεδόν, χωρίς να κλειδώσεις τα γόνατα.

nome_en: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
istruzioni: Gambe tese, solo la punta dei piedi sul bordo basso della pedana.
Spingi con le punte allontanando la pedana.
Torna lentamente fino a sentire i polpacci allungati.
istruzioni_en: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance.

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you without locking your knees. (Note: In some leg press units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your leg press unit allows for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the legs should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place your toes and balls of your feet on the lower portion of the platform with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Press on the platform by raising your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Πόδια τεντωμένα, μόνο οι μύτες στην κάτω άκρη του πατακιού.
Σπρώξε με τις μύτες απομακρύνοντας το πατάκι.
Γύρνα αργά μέχρι να νιώσεις τις γάμπες να τεντώνονται.

istruzioni: Schiena contro lo schienale, spalle sotto i cuscinetti, piedi alla larghezza delle spalle.
Togli le sicure e scendi piegando le ginocchia fino a circa 90°.
Spingi per tornare su senza bloccare le ginocchia.
istruzioni_en: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Πλάτη στην πλάτη του μηχανήματος, ώμοι κάτω από τα μαξιλαράκια, πόδια στο πλάτος των ώμων.
Βγάλε τις ασφάλειες και κατέβα λυγίζοντας τα γόνατα περίπου στις 90°.
Σπρώξε για να ανέβεις χωρίς να κλειδώσεις τα γόνατα.

istruzioni: Barra sulla parte alta della schiena, piedi un po' avanti rispetto alla barra.
Sgancia la barra e scendi come per sederti, schiena dritta.
Spingi per tornare su e riaggancia la barra alla fine.
istruzioni_en: To begin, first set the bar on the height that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side (palms facing forward), unlock it and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Μπάρα στο πάνω μέρος της πλάτης, πόδια λίγο μπροστά από τη μπάρα.
Ξεκλείδωσε τη μπάρα και κατέβα σαν να κάθεσαι, πλάτη ίσια.
Σπρώξε για να ανέβεις και κλείδωσε ξανά τη μπάρα στο τέλος.

istruzioni: Sdraiati sulla panca con la barra sopra il centro del petto.
Sgancia la barra e scendi lentamente fino a sfiorare il petto.
Spingi fino a braccia tese e riaggancia alla fine.
istruzioni_en: Place a flat bench underneath the smith machine. Now place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the flat bench. Using a pronated grip that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, lock the bar back in the rack.
istruzioni_el: Ξάπλωσε στον πάγκο με τη μπάρα πάνω από τη μέση του στήθους.
Ξεκλείδωσε τη μπάρα και κατέβα αργά μέχρι να αγγίξει σχεδόν το στήθος.
Σπρώξε μέχρι να τεντωθούν τα χέρια και κλείδωσε ξανά στο τέλος.

nome_el: Πιέσεις σε κεκλιμένο πάγκο στο Smith machine
istruzioni: Panca inclinata a circa 30°, barra sopra la parte alta del petto.
Sgancia e scendi lentamente fino a sfiorare il petto.
Spingi fino a braccia tese: lavora di più la parte alta del petto.
istruzioni_en: Place an incline bench underneath the smith machine. Place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the incline bench and make sure your upper chest is aligned with the barbell. Using a pronated grip (palms facing forward) that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
istruzioni_el: Πάγκος σε κλίση περίπου 30°, μπάρα πάνω από το πάνω στήθος.
Ξεκλείδωσε και κατέβα αργά μέχρι να αγγίξει σχεδόν το στήθος.
Σπρώξε μέχρι να τεντωθούν τα χέρια: δουλεύει περισσότερο το πάνω στήθος.

istruzioni: Barra sulla schiena, un piede avanti e uno indietro, come in un affondo.
Scendi piegando entrambe le ginocchia, il busto resta dritto.
Spingi con la gamba davanti per tornare su; poi cambia gamba.
istruzioni_en: To begin, place a flat bench 2-3 feet behind the smith machine. Then, set the bar on the height that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side (palms facing forward), unlock it and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
Position your legs by placing one foot slightly forward under the bar and extending your other leg back and place the top of your foot on the bench. This will be your starting position

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knee as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calf becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knee should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knee is past that imaginary line (if it is past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten your leg again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the movement.
istruzioni_el: Μπάρα στην πλάτη, ένα πόδι μπροστά και ένα πίσω, όπως σε προβολή.
Κατέβα λυγίζοντας και τα δύο γόνατα, ο κορμός μένει ίσιος.
Σπρώξε με το μπροστινό πόδι για να ανέβεις· μετά άλλαξε πόδι.

nome: Stacco a gambe tese al multipower
nome_el: Άρσεις με τεντωμένα πόδια στο Smith machine
istruzioni: In piedi con la barra davanti alle cosce, ginocchia appena piegate.
Porta il bacino indietro e scendi con la barra lungo le gambe, schiena dritta.
Torna su spingendo il bacino in avanti: lavorano femorali e glutei.
istruzioni_en: To begin, set the bar on the smith machine to a height that is around the middle of your thighs. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, grasp the bar using a pronated (palms forward) grip that is shoulder width apart. You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.

Lift the bar up by fully extending your arms while keeping your back straight. Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement

Start bringing your torso up straight again as soon as you feel the hamstrings stretch by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
istruzioni_el: Όρθιος με τη μπάρα μπροστά στους μηρούς, γόνατα ελάχιστα λυγισμένα.
Φέρε τη λεκάνη πίσω και κατέβα με τη μπάρα κατά μήκος των ποδιών, πλάτη ίσια.
Ανέβα σπρώχνοντας τη λεκάνη μπροστά: δουλεύουν οπίσθιοι μηριαίοι και γλουτοί.
